en.headline: Design@HKG opens two-week citywide programme with Peak bubble installation
en.dek: Hong Kong Design Centre's rebranded flagship runs until 24 November with more than 40 free and ticketed activations, including a multi-sensory inflatable at Peak Galleria.
body: Hong Kong Design Centre launched Design@HKG 2026 on Tuesday, a two-week programme of more than 40 design activations across the city that continues until 24 November.

The flagship event, previously known as BODW In the City, is supported by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency. It brings together local and international partners for installations, exhibitions, pop-ups and guided routes.

A highlight is BREATHE WITH ME—SOFT RESET, a multi-sensory inflatable installation by Swiss-born artist Annabelle Schneider at Peak Galleria. Free and open without booking from 11am to 9pm daily, it uses light, sound, scent and touch. Other activities include a floral-themed tram experience and city walking routes in Central and Causeway Bay.

zh.headline: 設計@HKG揭幕 山頂吹氣裝置免費開放至11月24日
zh.dek: 香港設計中心旗艦活動一連兩周於全港舉行逾40項設計項目，山頂廣場多感官裝置毋須預約免費入場。
body: 香港設計中心周二展開「設計@HKG」2026，活動至11月24日，在全港呈獻逾40項設計體驗，前身為BODW In the City。
項目由文創產業發展處主要贊助，聯同本地及國際伙伴舉辦裝置、展覽、快閃及導賞活動。
焦點是瑞士藝術家Annabelle Schneider的《BREATHE WITH ME—SOFT RESET》多感官吹氣裝置，於山頂廣場免費開放，每日上午11時至晚上9時，無需預約。其他包括中環花藝電車及中環至銅鑼灣漫遊路線。
